description: Walks 32 words of a fixed table, comparing three 4-bit fields of each with the matching input word and incrementing any field that differs before repacking it. The routine ends in an infinite loop and never returns.

name: swap_double_buffer_pointers

name: assign_buffer_pointer_slots
